summary.oneLiner: A holding company pivoting post-cement demerger to focus on rayon, transparent paper, and chemicals through its wholly owned subsidiary Cygnet Industries, leveraging cellulose chemistry for sustainable textile and packaging solutions.
summary.business: Kesoram Industries Limited, post the demerger of its cement business, has ceased standalone manufacturing operations and now operates as a holding entity. Its core business is conducted through its wholly owned subsidiary, Cygnet Industries Limited, which manufactures Viscose Filament Yarn (VFY) under the 'Kesoram Rayon' brand and Cellulose Transparent Film/Paper under the 'Kesophane®' brand. The company leverages high-quality cellulose chemistry derived from wood pulp to serve the textile and sustainable packaging markets.

one_liner.title: One Liner (RHP)
one_liner.body: A holding company pivoting post-cement demerger to focus on rayon, transparent paper, and chemicals through its wholly owned subsidiary Cygnet Industries, leveraging cellulose chemistry for sustainable textile and packaging solutions.

business_model.title: What they do
business_model.body: Kesoram Industries Limited, post the demerger of its cement business, has ceased standalone manufacturing operations and now operates as a holding entity. Its core business is conducted through its wholly owned subsidiary, Cygnet Industries Limited, which manufactures Viscose Filament Yarn (VFY) under the 'Kesoram Rayon' brand and Cellulose Transparent Film/Paper under the 'Kesophane®' brand. The company leverages high-quality cellulose chemistry derived from wood pulp to serve the textile and sustainable packaging markets.

group_structure.title: Group structure (subsidiaries / JV / related parties)
group_structure.body:
- Cygnet Industries Limited — subsidiary: Wholly owned subsidiary; operates Rayon, Transparent Paper & Chemicals business
- Gondkhari Coal Mining Limited — JV: Joint Venture (SPV) incorporated in 2009 for developing a coal block in Maharashtra; coal block de-allocated by Supreme Court in 2014; full provision exists against investment

end_markets.title: End Markets (RHP)
end_markets.body:
- Eco-conscious fashion and premium textiles (ethnic wear, festive garments, modern apparel)
- Sustainable packaging (fresh produce, biodegradable plastic alternatives)
- Export markets targeting OECD countries under potential zero-duty FTAs

demand_drivers.title: Demand & outlook drivers
demand_drivers.body:
- India's textile sector is undergoing a structural transformation towards Man-Made Fibre (MMF), with Viscose Filament Yarn (VFY) benefiting from rising demand for sustainable alternatives to cotton.
- Growing environmental awareness and stricter regulations are accelerating the shift toward biodegradable and plastic-free packaging solutions, driving demand for cellulose-based transparent films like Kesophane®.
- Ongoing anti-dumping investigations into VFY from China provide a more stable pricing environment and enable domestic manufacturers to improve capacity utilization.
- Anticipated zero-duty access under the India-EU FTA and rising global sustainability mandates create export growth opportunities for cellulose-based products.

capital_allocation.title: Strategy & capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- Refocus on core textile and specialty paper segments following cement business demerger.
- Pivot to address untapped potential by leveraging the global 'China plus One' shift and rising demand for certified bio-compostable packaging.
- No dividend proposed due to loss and non-availability of carry forward surplus; Dividend Distribution Policy available on website.
- 100% of employees and workers trained on health and safety measures and skill upgradation (FY26).
- Occupational health and safety management system integrated with ISO 45001:2018, covering risk assessment, training, line management responsibilities, and compliance.
- Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR) for workers at 0.39 per one million person hours worked.
- 100% of employees (permanent and other than permanent) provided training on human rights issues and policies.
- Median remuneration: male Board members ₹44,05,814/month; male employees other than BOD and KMP ₹4,92,168/month; female employees ₹43,475/month (KMP salary drawn from subsidiary).

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: Post demerger, the Company ceased standalone manufacturing operations and now focuses on the business of Rayon, Transparent Paper & Chemicals through its wholly owned subsidiary, Cygnet Industries Limited. The MD&A notes that the business is constrained by lower capacity utilization due to limited access to funds for essential Capex and working capital, and that the transition toward green manufacturing is capital-intensive. No specific capex project, capacity expansion, or commissioning timeline is disclosed in the provided text.

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- Core technical competency in wood-pulp-derived cellulose chemistry provides a competitive advantage in both VFY and transparent film markets.
- Established brand equity for 'Kesoram Rayon' and 'Kesophane®' in their respective segments.
- Kesophane® is positioned as a vital, non-toxic, biodegradable alternative to plastics, benefiting from regulatory tailwinds against plastic packaging.
